text:
Type: distressed medallion area rug
Use: anchoring a living area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: traditional, contemporary, modern
Materials: soft plush pile, distressed finish
Colors: charcoal grey, ivory
Shape: large rectangle, faded medallion and floral motifs with border, plush pile, generous size
Feel: soft, muted, cozy
Goes with: cognac leather, medium wood floors, neutral walls; transitional or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Charcoal Distressed Medallion Area Rug, 8 x 10 Foot
product.description: Pile: 100% Polypropylene, Backing: 100% Jute Imported Drawing inspiration from traditional Persian textiles, this design bursts with a bright, all-over medallion pattern. Durable, machine-woven synthetic fibers keep this rug looking fresh and feeling soft to the touch, even in high-traffic spaces. Area rug features a bright medallion pattern Machine-woven with 100% polypropylene fibers Low .2'' pile suits low- to high-traffic indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 8' x 10' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
